python3 -c "
import json, os
REPO = '/work/fastapi'
SRC_EXT = {'.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.go','.rs','.java','.c','.cc','.cpp','.h','.hpp'}
SKIP_DIRS = {'.git','node_modules','vendor','target','build','dist','__pycache__','.claude','examples'}

all_src = []
for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(REPO):
    dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d not in SKIP_DIRS and d != '.git']
    rel_dir = os.path.relpath(dirpath, REPO)
    parts = set(rel_dir.split(os.sep)) if rel_dir != '.' else set()
    if parts & SKIP_DIRS:
        continue
    for fn in filenames:
        ext = os.path.splitext(fn)[1]
        if ext in SRC_EXT:
            rel = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(rel_dir, fn)) if rel_dir != '.' else fn
            all_src.append(rel.replace(os.sep, '/'))

fastapi_pkg = sorted(p for p in all_src if p.startswith('fastapi/'))
others = sorted(p for p in all_src if not p.startswith('fastapi/'))
print('fastapi package files:', len(fastapi_pkg))
print('other src-ext files:', len(others))
tops = {}
for p in others:
    top = p.split('/')[0]
    tops[top] = tops.get(top,0)+1
print(tops)
"

  {
    "name": "middleware-and-concurrency",
    "kind": "infra",
    "role": "ASGI middleware FastAPI ships (CORS, GZip, HTTPS redirect, trusted host, WSGI, request-scoped cleanup) plus thread-pool helpers for running blocking code.",
